s2.ptxt: Secure the front axle assembly in a vise between aluminum plates.
Install the front axle hub with the dust cover and 4 bolts.
Install the front axle assembly LH to the shock absorber, insert the 2 bolts from the rear of the vehicle, and tighten the 2 nuts.
Push the front axle assembly LH toward the outside of the vehicle, engage the splines of the front drive shaft assembly LH, and insert it into the front axle assembly LH.

item.ptxt: Do not push the front axle assembly LH toward the outside of the vehicle more than necessary.
Do not damage the drive shaft outboard joint boot.
Do not damage the speed sensor rotor.
Check that there is no foreign matter on the speed sensor rotor or insertion part.

s-1.ptxt: Install Front Suspension Arm Sub-assembly Lower NO.1 LH

s2.ptxt: Push down the front suspension lower arm No.1 LH, install the front lower ball joint LH, and tighten it with the 1 bolts and 2 nuts.
Connect the tie rod end LH to the steering knuckle and install it with the castle nut.

atten3.ptxt: After tightening the castle nut, align the cotter pin hole by further tightening the nut within 60°.

s-1.ptxt: Temporarily Tighten Front Axle Shaft Nut LH

s2.ptxt: Temporarily tighten a new front axle hub nut LH.

s-1.ptxt: Inspect Front Axle Hub & Bearing Assembly Axial Play

s2.ptxt: Using a dial indicator, check the bearing axial play near the inner circumference (flange) of the axle hub.

atten3.ptxt: If it exceeds the maximum, replace the bearing with a new one.

s-1.ptxt: Inspect Front Axle Hub & Bearing Assembly Runout

s2.ptxt: Using a dial indicator, check the axle hub runout near the outer circumference of the axle hub.

atten3.ptxt: If it exceeds the maximum, replace the hub & bearing with a new one.

s2.ptxt: Align the matchmarks on the disc and axle hub, and install the disc.

atten3.ptxt: When replacing the disc, select the installation position where the disc runout is minimal.

s-1.ptxt: Install Front Disc Brake Caliper Assembly LH

s2.ptxt: Install the front disc brake caliper assembly LH to the steering knuckle with the 2 bolts.
Install the flexible hose bracket and speed sensor harness bracket at part A to the absorber bracket with the bolt.

atten3.ptxt: Install the flexible hose bracket first, then install the speed sensor harness bracket.

s2.ptxt: Install the flexible hose bracket at part B to the steering knuckle with the bolt.
Install the speed sensor FR LH to the steering knuckle with the bolt.

item.ptxt: When installing the speed sensor body, do not damage the tip of the speed sensor.
Do not allow foreign matter to get caught.
Do not twist the sensor wire when installing.

s-1.ptxt: Fully Tighten Front Axle Shaft Nut LH

s2.ptxt: Using a socket wrench (30mm), fully tighten the front axle hub nut LH.
Using a chisel and hammer, stake the front axle hub nut LH.
